as_told.title: Rossi taken by a blue energy humanoid

plain: Dave Rossi says that beings taught him advanced physics. On a podcast with host Jesse Michels he says that around 2021, at his home, he was taken in his sleep by what he calls a blue energy type humanoid. He told the same thing on a later episode, though there he gave no date or setting, and if true it would be the start of his contact with something not human.
